features.entry: New session composer → mode menu → opencode-omo
features.expect: The opencode-omo preset is offered with its omo description; choosing it mounts the plugin's role picker in the composer.
features.test: specs/preset.spec.ts::opencode-omo preset is offered and mounts the composer role picker

features.entry: opencode-omo session composer → role chip (角色：Sisyphus - Ultraworker)
features.expect: The chip opens a five-row menu of the omo primary/all roles; choosing a role updates the chip label and description; subagent-only roles are absent.
features.test: specs/role-picker.spec.ts::role picker lists primary omo roles and applies the chosen role

features.entry: opencode-omo session → mode menu → Standard mode
features.expect: The omo role chip is not rendered in a non-opencode-omo session.
features.test: specs/role-picker.spec.ts::role picker is hidden outside opencode-omo sessions

features.expect: The plugin page opens with the opencode-omo heading, its alignment intro, and the selected 角色设置 tab.
features.test: specs/role-settings.spec.ts::role settings page lists the complete omo role catalog

features.expect: All 14 omo role boxes render with display name, description, omo default chain, 主模型 selector, and the + fallback control.
features.test: specs/role-settings.spec.ts::role settings page lists the complete omo role catalog

features.expect: The menu offers 跟随当前 plus the catalog models; pinning a model updates the role box and survives closing/reopening Settings; 跟随当前 resets the row.
features.test: specs/role-settings.spec.ts::primary model selector pins a model, exposes reasoning effort, and follows the session again

features.entry: Role box with a pinned reasoning model → effort select
features.expect: The effort select appears under 主模型 with 默认 effort plus adapter efforts; the chosen effort is saved and survives reopening Settings.
features.test: specs/role-settings.spec.ts::primary model selector pins a model, exposes reasoning effort, and follows the session again

features.entry: Role box → + (添加 <role> fallback 模型)
features.expect: A model list opens below the role box with a search field; a picked model becomes a chip and the list stays open for repeated additions; picking the same model again shows 该模型已在 fallback 列表中.
features.test: specs/role-settings.spec.ts::fallback add panel appends chips, supports repeated additions, and rejects duplicates

features.expect: Typing filters the offered models; a non-matching query shows 没有匹配的模型.
features.test: specs/role-settings.spec.ts::fallback model search filters the list and reports no matches

features.entry: Fallback panel → 取消 (or toggling the + button)
features.expect: The panel closes without adding a fallback chip.
features.test: specs/role-settings.spec.ts::fallback panel cancel adds nothing and chips can be removed

features.expect: The chip is removed, and the Fallback 模型 list disappears once no chips remain.
features.test: specs/role-settings.spec.ts::fallback panel cancel adds nothing and chips can be removed

features.expect: The host slash menu lists the seven omo commands (start-work, remove-ai-slops, refactor, stop-continuation, handoff, hyperplan, team-mode) with their descriptions.
features.test: specs/commands.spec.ts::composer slash menu offers the seven omo commands

features.expect: The 16 skills shipped with the preset are offered in the slash menu with their descriptions.
